name: barbell split clean
description: A clean caught in a split stance instead of a squat. It trains the explosive pull and the catch.
instructions: Grip the bar just outside your legs with a flat back, shoulders over the bar.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Split your feet front and back and catch the bar on your front shoulders.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
